big_picture.title: Stock Market Drops On Hot Inflation Data, Rate-Hike Fears; Amazon Rides Relative Strength Toward Entry
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market dropped on hot inflation data and rate-hike fears Tuesday. Amazon stock rallied, closing in on a new buy point.
paragraphs: The stock market finished squarely lower Tuesday, as a hotter-than-expected inflation reading boosted the likelihood of a rate hike at next month's Federal Reserve meeting.
Meanwhile, Amazon (AMZN) stock continues to shrug off the ongoing market weakness, closing in on a new buy point.
